I now have all the information needed. Here are my complete findings:

---

## H14: Derived Memo Metadata (Payload) -- Computation, Triggers, and Extracted Data

### Where It Is Computed

The core computation is in `RebuildMemoPayload` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, lines 74-88. This function:
1. Ensures `memo.Payload` is initialized (as `&storepb.MemoPayload{}`).
2. Calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` -- a single-pass goldmark AST walk defined at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 355-422.
3. Sets `memo.Payload.Tags` (deduplicated list of `#tag` values) and `memo.Payload.Property` (the `MemoPayload_Property` struct).

The `ExtractAll` method (lines 355-422 of `markdown.go`) parses the memo content into a goldmark AST, then walks it once to collect:

| Extracted field | What it detects | Source lines |
|---|---|---|
| `Tags []string` | All `#tag` nodes in the markdown (deduplicated, case-preserving) | lines 376-378 |
| `Mentions []string` | All `@mention` nodes (lowercased, deduplicated) | lines 379-381 |
| `Property.Title` (string) | Text of the first block-level H1 heading, if the first block child of the document is an H1 | lines 384-389 |
| `Property.HasLink` (bool) | Whether any `Link` node exists | lines 393-394 |
| `Property.HasCode` (bool) | Whether any `CodeBlock`, `FencedCodeBlock`, or `CodeSpan` node exists | lines 396-397 |
| `Property.HasTaskList` (bool) | Whether any `TaskCheckBox` node exists | lines 399-400 |
| `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` (bool) | Whether any unchecked task checkbox exists | lines 401-403 |

The `MemoPayload_Property` proto is defined in `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto` (lines 15-22), and the full `MemoPayload` also includes `Location` and `Tags` fields.

Note: `Mentions` are extracted by `ExtractAll` but are **not** stored back into `memo.Payload` -- only `Tags` and `Property` are assigned (runner.go lines 85-86).

### Which Operations Trigger Recomputation

Three trigger sites:

1. **CreateMemo** -- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, line 108: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` is called before the memo is persisted.

2. **UpdateMemo** (when `content` field is in the update mask) -- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, line 447: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` is called after setting `memo.Content` to the new value, then `update.Payload = memo.Payload` is persisted.

3. **Runner.RunOnce** (batch rebuild of all memos) -- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, lines 27-72: Iterates all memos in batches of 100, calls `RebuildMemoPayload` on each, and writes the payload back via `Store.UpdateMemo`. This method is defined but is **not** called at server startup in the current codebase (unlike the s3presign runner). It exists as a utility for bulk recomputation.

---

## H15: Memo Visibility Enforcement Sites

Visibility has three values: `PUBLIC`, `PROTECTED` (authenticated users), and `PRIVATE` (creator only). Enforcement occurs in many distinct server surfaces:

### 1. GetMemo -- single-memo read access check
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, lines 39-68 (`checkMemoReadAccess`)
- Called at line 356 (GetMemo) and line 367 (parent memo check).
- If not `Public`: requires authentication. If `Private`: requires `CreatorID == user.ID`.

### 2. ListMemos -- query-time visibility filtering
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, lines 218-227
- Unauthenticated users: `VisibilityList = [Public]` (line 219).
- Authenticated viewing another user's memos: `VisibilityList = [Public, Protected]` (line 225).
- Authenticated viewing all memos (no creator filter): filter expression `creator_id == X || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]` (line 222).

### 3. ListMemoComments -- comment listing visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`, lines 148-161
- Calls `checkMemoReadAccess` on the parent memo (line 148).
- Then applies visibility filter on returned comments: unauthenticated gets `visibility == "PUBLIC"`, authenticated gets `creator_id == X || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]` (lines 158-161).

### 4. ListMemoReactions -- reaction listing visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`, lines 15-41 (`ListMemoReactions`)
- Inline visibility check (not via `checkMemoReadAccess`): if memo is not `Public`, requires auth; if `Private`, requires `CreatorID == user.ID` or superuser (lines 30-41).

### 5. UpsertMemoReaction -- reaction creation visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`, lines 60-85 (`UpsertMemoReaction`)
- If memo is `Private` and user is not creator and not superuser, denies permission (line 83).

### 6. ListMemoAttachments -- attachment listing visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go`, lines 213-225
- Inline visibility check: if not `Public`, requires auth; if `Private`, requires creator or superuser (lines 214-225).

### 7. Attachment access (gRPC API) -- attachment download visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`, lines 419-455 (`checkAttachmentAccess`)
- For linked attachments, checks the associated memo's visibility: `Public` allows all, `Private` requires creator or superuser (lines 436-453).

### 8. File server -- attachment file serving visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`, lines 674-703
- Public memos: served to anonymous visitors only if instance allows anonymous access (line 677).
- Share token fallback for private/protected (lines 684-689).
- Private memos: requires `user.ID == memo.CreatorID` or admin role (line 699).

### 9. RSS feeds -- public-only filtering
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go`, lines 90 and 141
- Both global RSS (line 90) and per-user RSS (line 141) set `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`, restricting feeds to public memos only.

### 10. Sitemap generation -- public-only
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go`, line 150
- `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}` -- only public memos appear in the sitemap XML.

### 11. User stats (ListAllUserStats) -- query-time filtering
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go`, lines 83-91
- Unauthenticated: `VisibilityList = [Public]` (line 84). Viewing another user: `[Public, Protected]` (line 90). Own memos: no visibility filter.

### 12. User stats (GetUserStats) -- per-user stats filtering
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go`, lines 217-221
- Unauthenticated: `VisibilityList = [Public]` (line 218). Viewing another user: `[Public, Protected]` (line 220).

### 13. SSE event delivery -- server-sent events filtering
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`, lines 134-144 (`canReceive`)
- Private events are delivered only to the creator or admin users (line 137). Public/Protected events go to all connected clients (line 138).

### 14. Memo relations -- relation listing visibility
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`, lines 108-112
- Filters related memos by visibility: unauthenticated sees only `PUBLIC` (line 109), authenticated sees own + `PUBLIC` + `PROTECTED` (line 111).

### 15. Memo relation converter (batch) -- relation loading
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`, lines 182-187
- Same pattern: unauthenticated gets `visibility == "PUBLIC"`, authenticated gets `creator_id == X || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]` (lines 184-186).
